answer: A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The ember counter is kept in gale and island publishes each reset. A hostile operator hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2743 identities would post 2783 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
